video.title: The Dashboard Etsy Won't Build
video.script: You're running your Etsy shop across a dozen browser tabs. Inventory over here, pending orders over there, and somewhere buried in the Etsy menus, your listing performance sitting ignored. Three of your listings are actively tanking your search rank right now. This dashboard shows you exactly which three and gives you the specific fix for each one. No tabs, no hunting. One page. Check it out with the link in the description.
